interlocks.cause: Guard door not closed (NOT X32) or E-stop chain lost (NOT X0)
interlocks.effect: Disable HiPot HV enable (Y30) and turn off HV beacon (Y31) immediately

interlocks.cause: Latched PASS (M310) or latched FAIL (M311) active
interlocks.effect: Disable HiPot HV enable (Y30) and HV beacon (Y31)
Reset latched results (RST M310, RST M311)

steps.entry: Pallet leaves ST30 (LDF X33) or startup
steps.exit: Pallet in ST30 (X33), guard door closed (X32), E-stop healthy (X0), and no latched result (ANI M310, ANI M311)
steps.name: IDLE

steps.entry: Pallet in ST30 (X33) AND guard door closed (X32) AND E-stop healthy (X0) AND NOT M310 AND NOT M311 (enables Y30 and Y31)
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (X30) or FAIL (X31), guard door opens (NOT X32), or E-stop lost (NOT X0)
steps.name: TESTING

steps.entry: Tester PASS received (X30 -> SET M310) or tester FAIL received (X31 -> SET M311)
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (LDF X33 resets M310 and M311)
steps.name: RESULT
